definitions.gloss: trend; tendency; the way things are heading
definitions.explanation: The general direction in which a situation, society, or industry is moving. A formal, literary word often used in analytical or journalistic writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趨勢|すうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆|さか}らえない→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧。
examples.english: You can't go against the trend of the times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趨勢|すうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脱炭素|だつたんそ}→脱炭素：06410_datsutanso⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{向|む}かっている→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The global trend is moving toward decarbonization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趨勢|すうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見極|みきわ}めて→見極める：07171_mikiwameru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めたい→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to assess the industry's trend before deciding on the investment.

notes:
Formal and literary; appears in news, analysis, and academic writing rather than casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趨勢|すうせい}: trend of the times
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{趨勢|すうせい}: global trend
- {趨勢|すうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow the trend
- {趨勢|すうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見極|みきわ}める→見極める：07171_mikiwameru⟧: to assess the trend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧: trend; movement — broader and more neutral, used for any kind of activity or shift
- ⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: tendency — a general inclination, less about large-scale direction
- ⟦トレンド→トレンド：06696_torendo⟧: trend — casual loanword, often about fashion or short-term popularity
